title: Among The Stars :UFO Hunting Simulator
description:
The relaxing UFO hunting experience.
Have you ever watched the CE5 videos and though to yourself 'I wish I could expeience that'? Well now you can, whenever you want and from the comfort of your own gaming chair.

Simple gameplay that you can control with just one hand - the mouse is all you need. Your other hand could be holding a cold beer or eating nachos, while you hunt those UFO's.

Multiple maps to choose from. YOU set the scene and keep your eyes on the skies. Make sure to eat and drink regularly. Also you'll need coffee... and lots of it, we're gonna be out here all night! Don't worry, you'll have a fire to keep you warm.

Enjoy the peaceful nature sounds and the crackle of the fire as you gaze the stars and ponder the universe's secrets.
description_short: The relaxing UFO hunting experience. Enjoy the peaceful nature sounds and the crackle of the fire as you gaze the stars and ponder the universe's secrets. Manage your hunger and stamina as you catch some UFO action swimming through the night sky. Some are satalites, but others... who knows?
